<div class="card-body">
'''Weapon Malfunction''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">武器の故障</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意のドッキング・ベイに配備する。宇宙戦闘機かビークルに配備された武器を1つ目標とする。その武器を起動することはできない。目標がウーティーニー・エフェクトに到達したら、ウーティーニー・エフェクトはキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Weapon-Malfunction-PSA-78732682.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「ルーク、火器管制装置が故障している。予備回路に切り替えないと」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Weapon Malfunction.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on any docking bay. Target one weapon deployed on a starfighter or vehicle. That weapon cannot be activated. Cancel the Utinni Effect when the target reaches it.

The original English uses “fired” for the disabled weapon. The Japanese face uses 起動する (activate). Both cancel the Effect on the target’s arrival.

'''Lore:''' “Luke, the fire-control system has failed. We’ll have to switch to the backup circuit.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 起動する (activate).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Weapon Malfunction]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
